before.title: Complex algebraic constructible complexes have finite conical cochain models
before.statement: Assume AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). For quasi-projective complex varieties and finitely many algebraic operations/support collections, the geometric suppliers give individually chosen compatible smooth Whitney strata, conical local products and finite deleted-boundary triangulation models for each operation. No simultaneous stratification of an arbitrary cyclic diagram respecting all marked supports is asserted. On any separated finite-type complex variety, bounded algebraically constructible objects have bounded finite ordinary and compact-support cohomology, ordinary derived Hom and bounded constructible internal Hom, with coefficient-extension compatibility, by these models locally and finite affine-open descent globally. A noncompact variety is not asserted to be a finite compact realization.
before.strategy: For each individual quasi-projective morphism and support collection, apply the compatible stratification theorem [[thm-complex-algebraic-varieties-and-maps-admit-compatible-finite-stratifications]], the conical-neighbourhood theorem [[thm-algebraic-whitney-strata-have-controlled-local-conical-neighborhoods]] and the finite coiled-model theorem [[thm-constructible-sheaves-admit-finite-stratified-triangulations-and-finite-local-cohomology]]; on the resulting finite deleted-boundary models the incidence theorem [[lem-finite-simplicial-constructible-sheaves-have-a-derived-incidence-model]] proves the finite local and global cochain statements, internal-Hom constructibility and field-extension comparison, and choices for different operations need not form one jointly stratified cyclic diagram. A separated finite-type variety has a finite affine open cover with affine intersections (the diagonal is closed and each two-chart intersection is a closed subscheme of a product of affine charts, iterated); each intersection is quasi-projective, so the local construction applies, and the finite Cech derived augmentation of [[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]] assembles the local models into global finite bounded complexes, with uniformly bounded amplitudes and coefficient-extension compatibility. Compact-support models are assembled by the ordinary open/closed support triangles and internal Hom is locally computed on the finite affine cover with uniform bounds. AC is assumed and inherited from the geometric and analytic suppliers ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).
before.axiom_use: AC is assumed and inherited from [[thm-algebraic-whitney-strata-have-controlled-local-conical-neighborhoods]], [[lem-compact-semialgebraic-families-admit-compatible-finite-triangulations]] (through [[thm-constructible-sheaves-admit-finite-stratified-triangulations-and-finite-local-cohomology]]), [[lem-finite-simplicial-constructible-sheaves-have-a-derived-incidence-model]] and [[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]] ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). The assembly over a finite affine cover is finite.

references.title: Beilinson-Bernstein-Deligne, Faisceaux pervers (Asterisque 100), 1.4 and 2.1 (constructibility and local cohomology); Bernstein-Lunts, Equivariant Sheaves and Functors, Part I (finite resolution construction)
